summary: Frontend verification of pricing/subscription link fix and guest access. All 4 role paths (guest, broker, photographer, property_owner) successfully open SubscriptionCenter via the appropriate entry point. Backend /api/finance/config?user_type=... verified for photographer and property_owner (returns proper plans/ad_products).

GUEST: clicking plan-subscribe-silver closes SC and opens the auth (login) modal (phone-input step). Verified by screenshot.

BROKER 0501234567: OTP login (+ role step where applicable) -> user-menu-trigger -> role-menu-subscription opens SC with billing-status=1, fee-simulator=1, transactions-list=1, all 4 plan cards visible, guest-cta=0.

PHOTOGRAPHER (fresh phone 0511122233 / 0513344556): OTP -> role-photographer -> auth-role-submit-btn -> verify-otp returned user_type=photographer. Menu item 'الاشتراك والباقات' (role-menu-subscription) present and opens SC with all 4 plan cards, billing-status=1, guest-cta=0.

PROPERTY_OWNER 0508765432: OTP -> role-owner -> submit -> menu 'الباقات والأسعار' opens SC showing AD PRODUCTS (5 ad-buy* buttons: free, standard, featured + 2 additional variants) and engagement models (نشر مجاني / الدفع لكل إعلان active; عقد وساطة & عقد تسويق marked قريباً). No subscription plan cards for owners (correct).

Backend regression: GET /api/finance/config?user_type=photographer returns 4 plans (partner/silver/growth/professional). GET /api/finance/config?user_type=property_owner returns plans=[] and ad_products list including free/standard/featured — matches expected owner behaviour.
